description: S15: Sun, Moon, Dragon Heads and the Dragon Tail on the real board (rules/boards/standard-9x9.json, rules/pieces/) under the draft 2-player ruleset. Expected moves come from plain geometry worked out independently of the engine (docs/RULES.md). The Coast is treated as open: opening it is game state, not movement.

moon defaults: unmoved on a8 steps one square or two straight forward (down)
